written_before: any trial of the main run (tag e7_main)
reason: The smoke run (tag e7_smoke, one trial per arm, porch) showed that the benign-floor scoring counted the laundering trials' own deletions of the author's events as untouched removals (3 rows, each first observed in its trial's edited second). Fix: the harness records deleted_event_ids and deleted_event_seconds per trial, and the verifier counts a removed or changed keylog row as touched when its current or first-observed second is touched. No parameter, arm, trial count, outcome or exclusion rule changed; per-arm detection of the smoke run was unchanged by the fix.

smoke_run.note: a test of the final code on the real deployment; its outputs are moved to the run directory and are not results
